svg.text: Looser depression casts a wider genetic net
Genetic correlation with depression defined by clinical assessment and from health records

text.font-family: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif

svg.text: EHR-defined depression correlates more strongly in 25 of 31; 6 reach p < 0.05, 0 survive Bonferroni.
The two definitions correlate at 0.857 (SE 0.045), and clinical heritability is 0.114 against 0.057.
The two GWAS share almost no people, so their noise does not cancel and single differences stay wide.
PGC MDD2025 EHR and clinical GWAS, FinnGen R12; shared-block jackknife
